title: Bug fix in an existing repo
goal: In this repo, splitBill(totalCents, n) in src/money.js sometimes returns shares that do not add up to the total (try 100 cents between 3 people). Fix it: the shares must always sum to totalCents, differ from each other by at most 1 cent, and the larger shares come first. Keep the function's name, arguments and errors. Add tests for the bug; `npm test` must pass.
